key_highlights: ASX set to extend losses following offshore tech weakness and BHP's steep sell-off marking the benchmark's worst decline in six weeks.
RBA minutes reveal board division with warnings of a sharper economic downturn as wage growth accelerates while real household purchasing power lags.
Consumer sector strain highlighted by 1,500 job cuts at David Jones and an active cyber incident investigation at Coles.
Energy equities demonstrate defensive resilience against broad market weakness, while miners and technology face renewed selling pressure.

sectors.trend: Broad sell-off in heavyweight iron ore producers alongside targeted exploration capital inflows into junior gold and antimony.
sectors.implications: BHP drag pressures the ASX 200 (^AXJO); investors should pivot to self-funded critical minerals and precious metals explorers.

sectors.trend: De-risking in domestic growth equities driven by US tech pullbacks and impending liquidity absorption from major offshore AI listings.
sectors.implications: Downside valuation pressure on high-multiple ASX tech constituents warrants near-term portfolio reduction.

sectors.trend: Discretionary retail restructuring intensifies amid elevated wage costs, while staples manage operational and cyber risks.
sectors.implications: David Jones creditor fallout highlights margin compression across discretionary retail; Coles faces near-term reputational scrutiny.

sectors.trend: Relative outperformance in ASX energy counters supported by local gas market tightness despite global crude overhangs.
sectors.implications: Domestic energy producers provide tactical hedging value against broader equity market drawdowns.

sectors.trend: Insurance premium inflation triggers consumer affordability strain, while banks navigate stagflation risks and monetary policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: Rising policy cancellation risks for insurers and elevated credit risk for major bank mortgage books under persistent rate pressure.

key_themes: Stagflationary wage-price dynamics eroding real consumer purchasing power
RBA policy trade-off between sticky inflation and an accelerating domestic downturn
Divergence between bulk commodity headwinds and strategic critical mineral demand
Rising corporate restructuring and insolvency activity in retail and professional services

risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase allocations to defensive dividend yield and short-duration cash equivalents.
Underweight major iron ore producers (BHP.AX, FMG.AX, RIO.AX) and utilize ASX index put options.
Avoid consumer discretionary exposure; favor market leaders in essential consumer goods.
Assess IT governance, compliance provisions, and customer retention metrics for major corporate holdings.

opportunities.recommendation: Targeted allocation to junior gold and strategic critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Prepayment facilities and active drilling programs offer idiosyncratic growth insulated from bulk commodity weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long exposure to domestic conventional energy
opportunities.rationale: Domestic gas scarcity and grid transition challenges provide firm revenue floors for established producers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to diversified bulk miners and high-beta tech
defensive_moves.rationale: BHP's sharp drop and offshore tech sentiment reversal indicate continued near-term index drag.
Persistent cost-of-living pressures and department store insolvencies signal deteriorating retail footfall and margins.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias over 1–3 months as the ASX 200 faces headwinds from falling commodity revenues, offshore tech multiple contraction, and pre-jobs data risk aversion.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral to cautious over 6–12 months, with recovery dependent on RBA rate trajectory clarity, Chinese industrial stimulus, and stabilizing real household incomes.
key_catalysts: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) monthly employment and unemployment report
Upcoming Reserve Bank of Australia monetary policy meeting and rate statement
US Anthropic IPO market absorption and global semiconductor demand trends
Chinese property and industrial production updates impacting iron ore demand
watch_list: Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao spot benchmark
